recipes.name: Charred Lemon Bean Toast
instructions: Warm the beans with lemon zest and a spoonful of water until creamy. Add White Beans and stir until evenly incorporated.
Toast the sourdough in a skillet, pile on the beans, and finish with charred lemon juice.
Measure fresh ginger and set it beside the cooking area.
Stir in butter, keeping the heat gentle so the flavors meld.
Add smoked paprika a little at a time and taste before adding more.
Fold through yellow onion until it is evenly distributed.
Cook fresh ginger briefly until its aroma becomes fragrant.
Add butter near the end so it stays fresh and bright.
Let the dish rest briefly, then finish with smoked paprika.
Use yellow onion to adjust the balance, then taste once more.
recipes.notesMarkdown: A bright pantry lunch; crisp toast contrasts with the soft beans.
